question: Can a bounded, licensed historical depth and time-and-sales source be normalized, reconstructed, and replayed reproducibly for MomentumBot's small-cap decision windows before any Level 2-dependent trading rule is defined?
hypothesis: At least one provider can supply timestamped depth, order or price-level changes, trades, definitions, and market status for a mechanically selected small-cap sample with enough integrity to derive deterministic liquidity, replenishment, velocity, and price-impact summaries.

frozen_parents.source_selection_basis: Every symbol-date whose already-frozen label-blind Micro-v0.1 replay recorded filled_count greater than zero; no Ross action, recap, outcome, later price, or P&L was used.

required_depth_fields: order ID when the schema supplies order events
book_state_requirements: clear or complete snapshot must precede book mutation
snapshot must reach an explicit last record before live updates
sequence must increase within each non-snapshot publisher channel; gaps are recorded rather than assumed absent because symbol filtering can skip venue-global messages
point-in-time symbol definitions and venue identity remain bound to every stream

engineering_cohort.smoke_selection_rule: Sort all 36 by causal SIP trade-row count, trading date, and symbol; select floor-spaced activity ranks 0, 11, 23, and 35.
engineering_cohort.result_use: The four smoke cases may establish data access, parsing, reconstruction, storage, and deterministic feature mechanics only. They cannot select thresholds or support performance claims.

prospective_evaluation_cohort.purpose: Only a later separately frozen feature policy may be evaluated behaviorally and economically on this prospective calendar.

provider_capability_candidates.historical_mbo_start_requirement: include the provider's start-of-day clear or snapshot needed for a complete book; do not begin from a convenient strategy timestamp unless the provider supplies a complete snapshot

provider_capability_candidates.documented_depth_method: reqMktDepth or reqMarketDepth with market-data subscriptions
provider_capability_candidates.documented_retail_api_constraint: TWS currently reports a maximum of three distinct market-depth requests

acquisition_windows.depth_mbo: For each smoke symbol-date, request enough history to include the provider's complete initial state and continue through 10:05 America/New_York; do not infer a book from 07:00-only deltas.
acquisition_windows.depth_mbp_10_and_tape: 06:55 through 10:05 America/New_York for strategy-window mechanics, with earlier records retained when required for state integrity.
acquisition_windows.definitions_and_status: Full relevant provider day, including halts, resumptions, symbol mappings, corrections, and data-quality flags.
acquisition_windows.time_standard: Store UTC nanoseconds and derive America/New_York session labels separately.

registered_feature_hypotheses.description: Best spread and displayed bid/ask quantity at declared depth levels.
Venue-scoped displayed bid-versus-ask depth imbalance with the covered levels and venue named explicitly.
Repeated displayed ask-size restoration after executions or removals at the same price.
Buy, sell, and unknown aggressor volume and event rates over fixed causal windows; unknown is never silently classified.
Number and notional of distinct price levels consumed over fixed causal windows.
Executed volume and repeated replenishment relative to price progress as a hidden-liquidity proxy, never proof of a specific hidden order.
Venue-scoped add, cancel, and modify rates without labeling intent or spoofing.
Aggressive buying and volume without sustained price progress through the declared breakout level.
Displayed-depth walk and conservative fill bounds for a declared order size, with queue position and hidden liquidity left unresolved until modeled.

gates.pass_condition: Provider metadata confirms every smoke symbol-date and produces an exact schema/date/symbol cost estimate inside a user-approved budget.
gates.failure_action: Preserve the quote or entitlement failure and do not download broad history.

gates.pass_condition: All four smoke cases expose the required fields, explicit venue scope, point-in-time definitions, usable timestamps, and complete initial depth state.
gates.failure_action: Reject the dataset or narrow the claim; never substitute SIP L1 for missing depth.

gates.pass_condition: Two independent normalizations and replays are byte-identical, all provider event counts reconcile, snapshot boundaries close, and no unflagged timestamp or sequence violation remains.
gates.failure_action: Stop before feature or execution modeling and preserve the diagnostic artifact.

gates.pass_condition: Every registered feature can be calculated causally with explicit unavailable states and no fitted threshold or transcript input.
gates.failure_action: Remove unsupported features from the future feature-policy registration; do not impute them.

gates.pass_condition: A separate feature policy is frozen before the August 24-September 4 results and later demonstrates incremental behavioral or execution value out of sample.
gates.failure_action: Do not promote Level 2-dependent entry, exit, or sizing authority.

explicitly_not_in_scope: buying data without an exact quote and user authorization
switching the two Alpaca paper accounts
claiming Nasdaq depth is consolidated national depth
using the four smoke cases for P&L or best-threshold selection
placing an LLM in the per-event critical path
assigning intent such as spoofing from cancellation rates
changing Micro-v0.1, scanner thresholds, or the prospective account panel

execution_status.next_gate: Obtain metadata-only availability and exact cost estimates for the four registered smoke symbol-dates without authorizing a purchase.
